home.title: From grey to play.
home.lead: The peripheral neighborhoods of Târgu Mureș have forgotten sports courts. This project documents the problem, proposes solutions, and mobilizes the people who want change.
home.problemBody: On the Cornești Plateau you find groomed parks and colourful facades. In Tudor or behind Auchan, the basketball court has cracks, the backboard is bent, the net is gone. Same authority, same local taxes — visibly different outcomes.
home.solutionFlipBody: Renovate existing courts with durable materials and realistic budgets — don't build from scratch, repair what we have.
home.solutionMuralBody: A mural on the asphalt, chosen by community vote and painted alongside local artists. The space becomes the neighborhood's.
home.solutionAdoptBody: Resident volunteers check on a court each week and report issues. Accountability without bureaucracy.

impact.title: Impact
impact.lead: Open data. Everything we document is available to anyone.
impact.explainBody: A score below 0.4 means: visible cracks in the surface, bent backboard or missing net, no working lighting. These details may look small, but they turn a playspace into a discouraging place.
